name: Piano Rhythm Tiles
desc:
🎹 Tap the tiles. Follow the rhythm. Find your next favorite song!
🎵 Play songs and choose your speed
🔥 Build up speed in Endless mode
🏆 Challenge another player in 1v1
📅 Take on a new Daily Song
🧠 Test your memory as tiles disappear in Fade mode
✨ Unlock tile skins and backgrounds
⭐ Earn stars, beat your best, and climb the leaderboards!
Play with touch, keyboard, or controller.
Can you keep the music going? 🎶
